name: ArmorFi
rootCause: The DeFi insurance project ArmorFi has paid a $1.5 million bug bounty to the white hat hacker Alexander Schlindwein. Because the hacker discovered a "critical loophole" in the agreement, and may cause all the company's underwriting funds to be depleted.
